name: Azata, Erotes
body:
Azata, Erotes
CR 2

This little angel-like creature appears as a human baby with multicolored wings on its back. It only wears a quiver full of golden and leaden-tipped arrows, and wields a gilded bow.

XP 600
CG Small outsider (azata, chaotic, extraplanar, good)
Init +4; Senses darkvision 60 ft., detect charm, detect desires, detect evil, low-light vision; Perception +6

DEFENSE

AC 14, touch 11, flat-footed 14 (+3 deflection, +1 size)
Hp 19 (3d10+3)
Fort +7, Ref +6, Will +4
DR 5/evil; Immune electricity, petrification; Resist cold 10, fire 10

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., fly 60 ft. (perfect)
Melee slam +4 (1d3)
Ranged shortbow +4 (1d4/x3)
Special Attacks arrow of love
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 3rd; concentration +6)

Constant—detect charm, detect desires (DC 16), detect evil
3/day—matchmaker (DC 16), reckless infatuation (DC 16), unadulterated loathing (DC 16)
1/week—commune (6 questions, CL 12th)

STATISTICS

Str 10, Dex 11, Con 12, Int 14, Wis 10, Cha 17
Base Atk +3; CMB +2; CMD 12
Feats Flyby Attack, Improved Initiative
Skills Bluff +9, Diplomacy +9, Fly +16, Knowledge (planes) +7, Perception +6, Perform (any one) +9, Sense Motive +6, Stealth +10
Languages Celestial, Common, Sylvan; truespeech
SQ love’s grace

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Arrow of Love (Su)

An erotes can transform every arrow shot by its bow into an arrow of charming or an arrow of hate (see page 13). Twice per day, the erotes can make the effects of one such arrow permanent.

Love’s Grace (Su)

An erotes adds its Charisma modifier as a racial bonus on all its saving throws, and as a deflection bonus to its Armor Class.

ECOLOGY

Environment any (Elysium)
Organization solitary, pair, or flight (4-40)
Treasure none

Erotes form Eros’ court and are sent by their master to spread love (and sometimes hate) among mortals. Due to their mischievous nature, sometimes their arrows cause more trouble than good, but erotes love to see happy couples and happy endings, and so will try to help those whose love is sincere.

A spellcaster may gain an erotes as a familiar at 7th level if she has the Improved Familiar feat and an alignment within a step of chaotic good.
